arcticfox: An arctic fox standing on all four legs in pure white winter coat, drawn with a LIGHT SOFT WARM-GREY OUTLINE rather than a heavy black one, and with VERY FEW INTERNAL LINES - no dense fur strokes, no drawn-in leg seams, no scribbled ruff texture, just the clean outer silhouette and a few soft pale grey shadows. The body, legs, face and tail are one flat clean white. Only the eyes and the small nose are dark. Minimal linework on a white animal so it does not read as black and scratchy
sandcat: A sand cat standing on all four legs, a small stocky short-legged pale sandy desert cat with a broad flat wide head and MODERATELY LARGE ROUNDED-TRIANGULAR EARS - noticeably larger than a house cat's but NOT huge, NOT bat-like, and NOT taller than the head is deep - set LOW AND WIDE ON THE SIDES of the skull and angled gently outward. Dense pale sandy fur, faint bars on the legs, a short black-ringed tail. Wide low ears in proportion, not oversized
cheetah_j: A CHEETAH CUB, a very young kitten, in full side profile facing left. It has CUB PROPORTIONS: a LARGE ROUND HEAD that looks too big for its body, a SHORT SMALL BODY, SHORT STUBBY LEGS and big paws, a rounded kitten face with large eyes and a short muzzle - clearly a baby animal, NOT a slim long-legged adult cheetah. A thick silver-grey mantle of long shaggy fur runs along the top of its neck, shoulders and back like a crest. Tawny spotted body, black tear stripes, short fluffy tail
pallascat: A Pallas's cat sitting, an extremely stocky short-legged small wildcat made round by very dense long fur, with a very wide flat face, a flat-topped head, and tiny low rounded ears set far apart low on the sides. Its coat is soft pale silver-ochre with white-tipped guard hairs, marked ONLY with a few NARROW SOFT FAINT DARK BARS across the flanks and narrow rings on the tail - THIN and SUBTLE and blended into the fur, absolutely NOT large solid black blobs, NOT thick heavy patches, NOT spilled-ink shapes. Delicate faint markings on a mostly plain pale coat
fishingcat: A fishing cat standing on all four legs, a robust stocky short-legged wildcat with a deep chest and a large broad head, olive-grey fur marked with SMALL NEAT EVENLY-SIZED DARK SPOTS arranged in tidy lengthwise rows along the back and flanks - each spot SMALL and DISCRETE, no bigger than the cat's eye, absolutely NOT large solid black blotches, NOT heavy merged patches, NOT spilled-ink shapes. Fine dark stripes over the crown, white muzzle, small low rounded ears, short thick ringed tail
jaguarundi: A jaguarundi standing ALERT WITH ITS HEAD RAISED HIGH, in three-quarter view facing the viewer, its neck lifted and body angled so the animal is TALL IN THE FRAME and fills it from top to bottom like a standing cat portrait. It is an otter-like cat: a long low slender body on short legs, a small flattened narrow head, small rounded ears set low and wide apart, and a very long thin tail curving up behind it. Coat COMPLETELY PLAIN uniform chestnut-brown with NO spots, NO stripes and NO markings of any kind. Head up, upright posture, filling the frame
bat: A fruit bat, a flying fox, IN FLIGHT with its WINGS FULLY SPREAD WIDE AND OUTSTRETCHED on both sides, seen from a three-quarter front view, gliding forward through the air. Its head is UPRIGHT AND FORWARD and clearly drawn: a FOX-LIKE HEAD with a long pointed muzzle, a black nose, large round dark eyes and two upright pointed ears, russet-brown fur on the head and body, and broad dark brown leathery wing membranes stretched between long finger bones. Wings open and flying, head the right way up
